skills.name: Human Writing
skills.author: KKKKhazix
skills.agents: Any agent that loads SKILL.md folders; the repository ships Codex interface metadata and a short paste-in version for chat apps such as ChatGPT and Qwen
skills.install: Ask your agent to install it from the repository URL, or copy the human-writing folder to ~/.agents/skills/
skills.language: Written for Chinese; the checker script rejects text with no Chinese characters
skills.produces: Articles, answers, stories and scripts in a plainer voice, plus a checker script (check_prose.py) for Chinese text

skills.name: Lemo-Opuscar
skills.author: Lemomo (LemoLab)
skills.license: MIT for the code; CC BY 4.0 for the demo films and stills
skills.agents: Built for Claude Code and tuned for Claude Opus 5.5; other agents can load the skill folder, but the README warns that other models may not reproduce the styles
skills.install: Run claude plugin marketplace add lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar, then claude plugin install lemo-opuscar@lemolab; or clone the repository and start Claude Code inside it
skills.language: Style names in English or Chinese; on-screen text in the language you ask for
skills.produces: Short films rendered in code or cut from archive footage (1920×1080 at 24 fps by default) in one of 59 styles, with an original score, sound effects, subtitles and optional text-to-speech narration

skills.name: Humanizer
skills.author: blader
skills.agents: Claude Code (as a plugin), Codex, Claude.ai and Claude Desktop (upload the repository ZIP as a skill), and the other agents the Skills CLI supports, such as Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and Windsurf
skills.install: In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add blader/humanizer, then /plugin install humanizer@humanizer; for other agents run npx skills add blader/humanizer --global with the agent name; in Claude.ai, upload the repository ZIP as a skill
skills.language: English; its patterns and examples are all English
skills.produces: A rewrite of your text with AI writing patterns removed and the facts kept; for pasted text it also shows a first draft and the patterns still left in it, and for a file it edits only the prose

skills.name: Replica
skills.author: Jake Schincariol
skills.agents: Claude Code (as a plugin or copied skill folders); any single SKILL.md can be pasted into a chat app, without the Python tools
skills.install: In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add Jakeschincariol/replica-skill, then /plugin install replica-skill@replica-skill; or copy the replica-* folders to ~/.claude/skills/ or the project's .claude/skills/
skills.produces: Eleven steps of files in a replica folder: a recon map and feature spreadsheet of the original app, architecture and design plans, your rebuilt app and backend, tests, a feature comparison, business, brand and launch notes, and a deploy step gated by a brand sweep

skills.name: Ponytail
skills.author: Dietrich Gebert
skills.agents: Claude Code and Codex as plugins with hooks; plugins or extensions for Copilot CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Antigravity CLI, Cursor (hooks) and others; a rules file (AGENTS.md or the matching rules folder) for Windsurf, Cline, Copilot Chat, Kiro, Aider, Zed and similar
skills.install: In Claude Code send /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail, then /plugin install ponytail@ponytail as a second prompt; in Codex run codex plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail and codex plugin add ponytail@ponytail, then trust its two hooks in /hooks; other agents follow INSTALL.md or copy AGENTS.md into the project
skills.language: Any programming language; instructions in English
skills.produces: No files of its own: an always-on rule set that makes the agent reuse existing code and platform features before writing new code, plus review, audit and shortcut-ledger commands

skills.name: Impeccable
skills.author: Paul Bakaus
skills.agents: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Replit Agent, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, Kiro, Trae, Rovo Dev, Qoder, Mistral Vibe, Pi, Hermes Agent, DeepSeek Harness and Veto
skills.install: Run npx impeccable install in your project and accept the design hook, or in Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add pbakaus/impeccable and install it from /plugin
skills.language: English commands; works on any web front end (HTML, CSS, JSX, TSX and the common frameworks)
skills.produces: Edits to your front-end code from 24 design commands (polish, bolder, quieter, audit, critique and more), plus a detector with 62 rules for common AI design tells

skills.name: Superpowers
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Prime Radiant)
skills.agents: Claude Code, Codex (app and CLI), Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, Devin, Factory Droid, Grok Build, Pi, Qwen Code, Hermes Agent and Muse
skills.install: In Claude Code run /plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official; other agents install it from their own plugin marketplace or from the repository
skills.language: English; works with any programming language
skills.produces: A set of 15 workflow skills (brainstorming, plans, test-driven development, debugging, code review, git worktrees) that the agent loads on its own when a task matches

skills.name: Cloudflare security-audit
skills.author: Cloudflare
skills.agents: Coding agents that support tool use and parallel subagents, such as Claude Code; installed with the Skills CLI, which supports many agents
skills.install: npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill --skill security-audit (add --global for every project)
skills.language: English; audits code in any language, with extra guides for web, native, cloud, LLM, mobile and supply-chain targets
skills.produces: A security audit folder: REPORT.md, FINDINGS-DETAIL.md, NEEDS-VALIDATION.md, findings.json checked against a schema, a coverage ledger and the reproduction scripts

skills.name: Taste Skill
skills.author: Leon Lin (Leonxlnx)
skills.agents: Claude Code and Codex (plugins), plus the other agents the npx skills CLI installs into
skills.install: Run npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill --skill "design-taste-frontend", or in Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add Leonxlnx/taste-skill, then /plugin install taste-skill@taste-skill
skills.language: English; works on any web front end (plain HTML and CSS, React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Tailwind)
skills.produces: A landing page, one-pager or app screen built from a dealt art direction, with credited open-licence pictures and screenshots from its own browser check

skills.name: rea-video
skills.author: June (JuneYaooo)
skills.license: MIT, as stated in plugin.json and pyproject.toml; the repository has no LICENSE file
skills.agents: Claude Code (as a plugin) and Codex; any agent that can run shell commands and, ideally, look at images
skills.install: Ask your agent to install it from the repository URL, or run pip install "rea-video[ocr] @ git+https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video" for the command-line tool and add the skill with /plugin marketplace add JuneYaooo/rea-video, then /plugin install rea-video@rea-video; needs ffmpeg and Python 3.10 or later
skills.language: Works on videos in any language (on-screen text is read in Chinese and English, or Japanese); the agent replied in English when asked, but report.html, report.md and the generated prompts are in Chinese
skills.produces: A shot-by-shot breakdown of how a video was made (filmed, AI video, 3D, code-rendered, screen recording and more), its captions, edit and sound, a remake plan, and report.html, report.md, breakdown.json, frame sheets and separated voice and music tracks
